prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Paint exactly ONE original Turnip Works tabletop condition pictogram for concentrating: TWO cupped ivory cartoon hands holding up ONE big glowing sky-blue magic orb with a bright white core between them, three short sky-blue sparks around the orb: holding a spell. No face, no head. Bold dark outlines, chunky shapes, floating alone. Dominant subject colour key: glowing sky blue; keep this colour strongly visible, not just a tiny accent. Heroic hand-painted style D, chunky matte painted forms, broad soft bevels, restrained brushwork. Center on a dark charcoal circular ground with a quiet thin slate rim. Upper-left light. Straight-on circular badge; outer circle fills 94 percent of square canvas, pictogram fills 80 percent of disc. Readable at31px and smaller: bold silhouette, thick features, generous negative space, absolutely no tiny detail. Native transparent alpha outside the circle. No text, lettering, numbers, watermark, decorative flourishes or extra scene. Our own design, no trademarked game iconography. Style reference: the attached images are our own earlier Turnip Works ring icons from this same set; match their circular ground, rim, painted brushwork, bevels, lighting and palette exactly, as if painted by the same artist in the same sitting. Do not copy their subjects. No third-party references.
